about_the_game:
Synopsis:

The Moon was shattered. A mysterious impact knocked it off course, and now it's on a slow, inevitable collision with Earth. Humanity's last hope lies in three massive colony ships bound for the closest thing to a new Earth, Proxima B.

You play as Sister Zola, a nun, psychiatrist, and high-ranking officer, tasked with protecting the minds of the colonists during their long cryosleep. But hyperspace, as you will soon discover, is not empty, for some devils have found their way through.

When the Argos jumps into the unknown, reality fractures. The crew loses their minds or their souls. Some awaken changed, twisted into nightmare beings. Rogue machines stalk the corridors. The ship itself becomes a hostile, ever-shifting maze.

Armed with faith, newfound powers, and your precious staff, you must fight your way through the shattered halls of Argos. Save who you can. Destroy what you must. And pray that, in the abyss of hyperspace, you don't lose your soul too.

Key Features:

  • Tactical Combat: Every encounter demands thought. Cooldowns govern your abilities, positioning determines survival, and timing separates victory from failure. Each confrontation requires careful consideration of when to strike, where to stand, and how to react. 

  • Narrative-Driven Exploration: The Argos was meant to carry humanity to safety. Now its corridors echo with madness and whispers from the void. Piece together what happened when the ship entered hyperspace through scattered logs, twisted crew testimonies, and signs that defy explanation. As Sister Zola, uncover the truth behind the corruption that has taken hold, and face impossible choices about who can still be saved and who is beyond redemption. Your decisions shape both the story's outcome and the ship's fate.

  • Build Flexibility: Your abilities adapt to your approach. Channel Zola's powers through devastating spells, hone your skills in close combat, or perfect ranged precision. No rigid classes, so you can shift between styles as the situation demands or the story unfolds.

  • Haunting Atmosphere: The ship itself tells the story: flickering lights reveal traces of struggle, distant echoes hint at unseen horrors, and corrupted transmissions bleed through the silence. Every sound and shadow contributes to the unraveling mystery of what hyperspace has done to the Argos and its inhabitants.

  • Streamlined Experience: No cluttered menus or resource management to break the tension. 2nd EVE keeps the interface minimal and purposeful, stripping away inventory screens so nothing pulls you out of the moment. The story lives in the environment itself, told through the ship's decaying corridors, scattered crew logs, and the silent evidence of what ARGOS has done to the people left behind. When the horror speaks, you are already inside it.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: i3-10100 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD X 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p resolution, low settings, stable at 30+ FPS
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5-12400 / Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 / AMD RX 6800 XT (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1440p resolution, high settings, stable at 60+ FPS
